items.title: What is governance?
items.explanation: Governance is the process of taking decisions, organizing society's life with different sets of rules, and ensuring that these rules are followed. The group of individuals or the system that makes the rules and ensures they are followed is called a government.

items.title: What is democracy?
items.explanation: Democracy means having a say in the laws and rules governing society. It is important because it allows citizens to participate in decision-making, ensuring that rules reflect the will of the people and maintain social harmony.
